findings.finding: The previous lead conflated amount with schedule and asserted that FDA required dose comparisons.
findings.resolution: The amount, dosage, cumulative amount and intensity are separated; the August2024 FDA recommendation is dated, nonbinding and scoped. Existing notes, links, aliases, relationships and provenance remain.

findings.observation: Older unembedded artwork asks whether a drug reaches its target in the engagement panel. Reaching a compartment alone does not establish target interaction. Its effect and clinical bar graphics have no defined measurement scale or named study.
findings.disposition: Assess these legacy assets separately and record the limits; no silent acceptance borrowed from the embedded v2 pair.

findings.finding: The2009 DOI metadata resolves, but its alleged Figure3A correction body was not read. The DOI yielded a meta-refresh landing page and its public publisher destination returned403.
findings.resolution: No figure-specific correction claim or complete-original-paper reading is credited.

findings.finding: Four scoped CETSA units have exact field evidence only in frozen PR371.
findings.resolution: Keep their peer status; the root graph does not register that owner, so no root API/reader or integration acceptance is claimed.

findings.finding: Eight language values and the simple-level value retain the older amount/schedule wording.
findings.resolution: All nine stored values and availability are preserved; align them through the existing summary/language workflow. No language review is claimed.

findings.finding: The later-only combination table uses killing-probability language alongside an explicitly different growth-inhibition toy. Generic model ordering needs its stated bounded assumptions.
findings.resolution: The current owner names its72-hour viable-count inhibition endpoint, Chou method scope and different HSA/Bliss/Loewe assumptions. Do not silently transfer a death endpoint to that illustration.

findings.finding: Selected records contain older disease-specific clinical, resistance, and known-biology model-validation assertions outside the scoped asset clauses.
findings.resolution: Reading the whole fields is not fresh support for every retained assertion. In particular the known-biology recovery record was not repurposed as the pharmacological mechanism owner.
